commands.name: m113_matched_history_outcome_gate

decision_rule: Admit the M111/M112 surface for training only if normal history improves rollout outcome relative to reset, delayed, zero-action, and wrong matched history on clearance, collision, success, or mitigation metrics.
failure_criteria: action changes from M112 do not produce measurable outcome differences
wrong-history or reset-history variants perform as well as normal history
normal continuation success or clearance regresses below the current baseline
the gate relies on hidden parameters or oracle labels as actor inputs
hypothesis: M112 shows action-level history sensitivity on M111 matched pairs. The next proof must determine whether that sensitivity matters for closed-loop safety outcomes rather than only first-action distance.
success_criteria: M112 action-intervention rows are replayed or reconstructed as continuations
normal/reset/delayed/zero-action/wrong-history variants are compared on outcome metrics
clearance, collision, success, mitigation, and action-distance metrics are recorded
the result decides whether to train an outcome-weighted intervention objective
